about: C-339: the setup steps WHAT'S NEW opens, one per ticket, kept by hand. server/tools/whatsnew.py copies each into every section of whatsnew.json that names the ticket, as the section's "setup". Fields: title (the sheet's header), steps (what to do, in order; required), needs (devices, servers and settings it needs), where (where it lives in the app), wiki (a page of the public wiki, Page-Name or Page-Name#anchor), book (a HOW TO PLAY book: micro, quick, player, companion, watch, tiiny, social), draft. {hub} in a step is the hub's address as the app knows it. Every word DRAFT until the user reads it.

C-330.title: THE ENGINE ROOM
C-330.where: a web app on the hub, at /admin/
needs: the home network or the tailnet
steps: On the home network or the tailnet, open {hub}/admin/ in a browser, or tap any ENGINE ROOM link in the app.
Pair it once: hold the hub's screen for two seconds and type the code it shows.
To keep it as an app, add it to the home screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen).

C-334.title: SLEEP SOUNDS
needs: the music maker beside THE TIINY's LiteLLM (port 4002)
steps: The pieces are made by ACE-Step on the machine that runs THE TIINY's LiteLLM. From the DAEMONS repository, copy ai/litellm/sleep-sounds/ to that machine and run its install.sh there. It answers on port 4002 and turns away anyone without a key.

The hub finds it beside THE TIINY: SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK › THE TIINY, its address on port 4000 and its key. The hub knocks on port 4002 of the same machine with the same key (the hub's sleep.url setting names another door).
Open DAEMON › DREAMS. SLEEP SOUNDS asks for tonight's piece, made from your daemon's day; the first takes a few minutes, and then it is kept on the phone.
It plays for thirty minutes and fades over the last ten.
DRIFT DOWN needs headphones: put them on first. On a speaker it waits, and the music plays alone.

C-329.title: DAEMONS IN DIALOGUE
C-329.where: YOU › TRADE › OUT TOGETHER, and YOUR HOUSEHOLD
needs: THE TIINY, or another mind the hub can ask
another player on the exchange, or two of the home's devices
steps: With another player: join the exchange (YOU › TRADE › JOIN THE EXCHANGE, with a code made in THE ENGINE ROOM › EXCHANGE), send your daemon OUT TOGETHER with theirs, and IN DIALOGUE is under it.
In your home: put two of the household's devices TOGETHER under YOUR HOUSEHOLD on the same page, and IN DIALOGUE appears there.
Pick STANDARD or TWO VOICES and how many turns. THE TIINY thinks first (SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK); with no mind answering, the talk cannot start.

C-331.title: BOOKS AND DREAMS ON THE WATCH
C-331.where: the T-Watch Ultra: BOOKS › a chapter › LISTEN
needs: a T-Watch Ultra linked in PLACES, with its card in
steps: Link the watch to the hub in PLACES, and leave its card in.
On the watch, open BOOKS, pick a chapter and press LISTEN. The first time, the hub cuts that chapter from the book's own recording, in seconds; after that the watch plays it from its card.
A book whose reading is sealed is read in the INDEX voice instead.

C-328.title: BATTLES
needs: a device online, or another player on the exchange
steps: YOU › BATTLE lists the household's devices that are online (each linked in PLACES) and the players on the exchange.
Pick one and send the request; the battle is drawn over every screen when it is accepted.
Boards and watches cannot answer a battle yet: their half waits on their firmware.

C-338.title: THE EASEL
needs: the hub (not a phone on its own)
an image maker: ComfyUI, on port 8008 of the house's machine
steps: The hub paints on ComfyUI at http://roverbyteseer:8008, unless its easel.host setting names another. That machine needs ComfyUI running, with its image model loaded.
Carry a daemon: THE EASEL › appears under its card on DAEMON › Yours.
Type what to paint. It takes a minute or two; the daemon walks to its easel while it works.
THE GALLERY keeps every painting: tap one to see it large, hold it to see what was asked.

C-327.title: YOUR HOUSEHOLD
needs: a second device of the household, linked in PLACES
steps: Link a second device to the hub (PLACES): another phone, a board or a watch.
YOU › TRADE › YOUR HOUSEHOLD shows each device and the daemon it carries.
TOGETHER puts both daemons in one den; SWAP trades them between the two devices. A care given on either is seen on both.

C-337.title: THIS PHONE'S NAMES
needs: a phone paired to the hub
steps: Open SETTINGS (the gear) › THIS PHONE.
Type the phone's name on the companion, and what your daemon calls you, and save.
